name: video-agent
description: Summarize any video, local or from a link: prepare its transcript and representative frames with the Video Agent CLI, look at the frames, and write a timestamped summary. Windows only.

interface.longDescription: 总结本地视频或链接里的视频：先用已有字幕，没有字幕时经你同意用必剪转录；抽取代表画面，按需补截画面，写出带时间点的总结。
defaultPrompt: 这个视频里第 3 分钟那张图表说了什么？
